SSR Markup​

<ui-disclosure>
  <button type="button" aria-controls="faq-a1">What is light DOM?</button>
  <div id="faq-a1" hidden>Inspectable SSR markup with progressive behavior.</div>
</ui-disclosure>

Framework Snippets​

  • React
  • Vue
  • Svelte
import { Disclosure } from "@ui/react";

export function Example() {
  return (
    <Disclosure onOpen={(detail) => console.log(detail)}>
      <button type="button" aria-controls="faq-a1">What is light DOM?</button>
      <div id="faq-a1" hidden>Inspectable SSR markup with progressive behavior.</div>
    </Disclosure>
  );
}
import { h } from "vue";
import { Disclosure } from "@ui/vue";

export const Example = {
  setup() {
    return () =>
      h(Disclosure, { onOpen: (detail: unknown) => console.log(detail) }, {
        default: () => [
          h("button", { type: "button", "aria-controls": "faq-a1" }, "What is light DOM?"),
          h("div", { id: "faq-a1", hidden: true }, "Inspectable SSR markup with progressive behavior.")
        ]
      });
  }
};
<script lang="ts">
  import { bindAdapter } from "@ui/svelte";
  const options = { onOpen: (detail: unknown) => console.log(detail) };
</script>

<ui-disclosure use:bindAdapter={options}>
  <button type="button" aria-controls="faq-a1">What is light DOM?</button>
  <div id="faq-a1" hidden>Inspectable SSR markup with progressive behavior.</div>
</ui-disclosure>
